title: RNK Curator Issue Pattern
description: A detectable code or behavior pattern indicating a compatibility issue. Formalizes the IssuePattern shape used by the Tync's IssuePatternRegistry.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract the entry conforms to.

id.description: Stable identifier, kebab-case. Consumers key registries on this.

match.description: How the pattern is detected. Exactly one mechanism per entry.

kind.description: Detection mechanism: regex over source or bytecode strings, or a symbolic bytecode shape.

pattern.description: For kind=regex: the regular expression (Java flavor).

shape.description: For kind=bytecode-shape: structural description (owner, method name/descriptor patterns).

remediation.description: Human-readable guidance for resolving the issue.

fixRef.description: Optional id of a fix-pattern entry in the same bundle that automates the remediation.

source.description: Provenance: who authored the entry (curator id, org, or individual).
